question: PM Narendra Modi laid the foundation stone for water supply project in which state through video conferencing in July 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **PM Narendra Modi laid the foundation stone for the water supply project in Manipur through video conferencing on 23 July 2020. Hence, Option 1 is correct.**
 
• This project will give clean drinking water to Greater Imphal and 1,700 villages in Manipur.
 
• The fund for the project has been provided by the Centre under ‘Jal Jeevan Mission’ to provide freshwater household tap connections to 1,185 habitations with 1,42,749 households.
 
• Manipur: 
 
 
• Number of Districts - 16.
 
• Lok Sabha seats - 2.
 
• Rajya Sabha seats - 1.
 
• State Animal - Sangai.
 
• State Bird - Mrs. Hume's pheasant.
 
• National Park - Keibul Lamjao National Park.
 
• **Chief Minister:** Nongthombam Biren Singh** (As of Feb 2022).**
 
• **Governor: **La. Ganesan (As of Feb 2022).
